issues.t: Airbag light from failed passenger presence sensor
issues.sym: A "Service Airbag" message and airbag warning light at every start, often with code U0170, and the passenger airbag may be switched off.
issues.why: The sensor kit in the passenger seat that tells the airbag computer someone is sitting there fails on both 2014 and 2016 ELRs, sometimes at low mileage. Several owners report dealers saying the GM replacement part was hard to get or discontinued.
issues.next: Treat the passenger airbag as not working and keep passengers out of that seat if you can. Have a dealer read the codes and check your VIN for open recalls. If the dealer says the part is unavailable, ask them to search other GM part numbers and dealers, and consider filing a complaint at nhtsa.gov.

issues.t: Stability control may not warn when disabled (recall)
issues.sym: Usually nothing you would notice; the car may fail to show a warning when stability control is partly or fully off.
issues.why: Some 2014 ELRs built from September 2013 to February 2014 without adaptive cruise had brake control software that hid certain stability control faults. Recall 14V-144 reprograms the module.
issues.next: Check your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls and have the free software update done at a Cadillac dealer.

issues.t: Front seat bracket weld may be incomplete (recall)
issues.sym: No symptoms. In a crash, a front seat could come loose.
issues.why: Recall 14V-446 covers ELRs whose front seat hook bracket weld may be incomplete. Dealers inspect the weld and replace the lower seat track if needed.
issues.next: Check your VIN for recall 14V-446 and have the free inspection done.

issues.t: High-voltage battery pack needs repair or replacement
issues.sym: Shorter electric range, a "Service High Voltage Charging System" or similar message, the engine running more than usual, or reduced power.
issues.why: The ELR shares its battery design with the first-generation Chevy Volt. GM bulletin 19-NA-242 announced a refurbish kit for 2014-2016 ELR packs that need replacement, and dealers also replace individual battery sections and rebalance the pack.
issues.next: Have the battery codes read at a GM dealer and ask whether a section repair or refurbish kit applies. Ask whether the high-voltage battery warranty still covers your car.

issues.t: "Propulsion Power is Reduced" on higher-mileage cars
issues.sym: A "Propulsion Power is Reduced" message with the car feeling slow, often with no trouble codes stored.
issues.why: GM bulletins for the 2016 ELR describe this message on higher-mileage cars with no codes, and one bulletin calls for reprogramming the hybrid control module (HPCM2).
issues.next: Drive gently and get to a Cadillac or Chevrolet Volt-trained dealer. Mention bulletin 19NA079 so they check for the software update.

issues.sym: On long mountain climbs the car shows "Propulsion Power is Reduced" and won't accelerate as hard.
issues.why: If the battery is drained to its reserve on a long climb, the gas generator alone can't supply full power. GM bulletin PIP4869 tells dealers to explain Mountain Mode, which saves battery charge for climbs.
issues.next: Before a mountain trip, turn on Mountain Mode while the battery is still well charged. No repair is needed if this is the only symptom.

issues.t: Car shuts down completely while driving
issues.sym: While driving, everything goes dark: lights, brakes assist, steering assist and door controls. The car may restart afterward.
issues.why: NHTSA and CarComplaints reports describe sudden total power loss on 2014 ELRs. Dealers often could not reproduce it or find codes, so the cause is not confirmed.
issues.next: If it happens while you're driving: turn on your hazard lights, hold the wheel firmly and steer to a safe spot off the road. Steering and brakes can feel much heavier when the engine or power cuts out, so press the brake harder than normal. Have it checked before you drive it again. If it happens, steer firmly and brake hard to stop as safely as you can, then turn on hazards. Do not keep driving it on highways until a dealer has checked it; ask them to save any stored data right after an event.

issues.t: "Shift to Park" message won't let the car turn off
issues.sym: The car says it isn't in Park even though it is, so it won't shut down until you move the shifter several times or cycle power.
issues.why: Owners report the shifter position not being recognized. The same message is a known complaint on the related Chevy Volt, but the cause has not been confirmed for the ELR.
issues.next: Set the parking brake before leaving the car. Have the dealer check the shifter switch if it keeps happening.

issues.t: Won't charge or won't shift out of Park from a bad charge port
issues.sym: The car won't charge when plugged in, may show charging codes, and sometimes won't shift out of Park.
issues.why: GM bulletin PIC6015 covers 2014 ELRs whose charge receptacle has tiny cracks or water inside it, which confuses the charging system. An updated receptacle was released.
issues.next: Try another charger and cord first. If it still won't charge, ask a dealer to inspect the charge port per bulletin PIC6015.

issues.t: Won't charge with check engine light on
issues.sym: The car won't charge on a 120V or 240V charger, and the check engine or service light comes on.
issues.why: Several GM bulletins for the 2016 ELR cover no-charge conditions with warning lights, including charger faults and high-voltage isolation faults.
issues.next: Rule out the charging station and cord first. Then have a dealer read the codes; don't keep running only on gas without getting it checked.

issues.t: No start or "Battery Saver Active" from weak 12V battery
issues.sym: The car won't power on, shows "Battery Saver Active" or a red battery symbol, or says the battery is too cold.
issues.why: Like the Volt, the ELR needs its small 12-volt battery to wake up the high-voltage system. GM bulletins cover battery-saver warnings and no-start conditions where both the 12V and high-voltage batteries must be tested.
issues.next: Try a jump start on the 12V battery terminals. If it keeps happening, have the 12V battery load-tested and replaced.

issues.t: Sudden loss of power steering assist
issues.sym: Steering suddenly gets heavy and a "Service Power Steering" message appears.
issues.why: GM bulletin PI1521 covers loss of electric power steering assist on the ELR, with a fix of replacing the power steering fuse.
issues.next: If the steering suddenly turns heavy, grip the wheel with both hands, slow down, and pull over where it's safe. Don't drive on — have it towed and checked. You can still steer with more effort.

issues.t: CUE touchscreen freezes or stops responding
issues.sym: Dead spots on the touchscreen, a frozen screen, a "waiting for update" screen, or controls for climate and audio that stop working.
issues.why: NHTSA complaints on 2014 ELRs describe the CUE screen freezing, and a GM bulletin for 2016 covers a stuck update screen that needs reprogramming.
issues.next: Pull over before fiddling with a frozen screen. A restart may clear it; if it keeps happening, ask the dealer about a software update or screen replacement.

issues.sym: A slow tire leak, vibration, or a visible crack on the inside of a wheel.
issues.why: One NHTSA complaint describes all four original 20-inch wheels and a replacement cracking.
issues.next: Have the inner wheel rims checked if a tire keeps losing air. A cracked wheel can fail suddenly and should be replaced.

issues.sym: Front tires wear unevenly or feel tight in the steering, even after an alignment.
issues.why: Owners report the front tires wearing unevenly early.
issues.next: Check tire pressures monthly and rotate on schedule. Ask for a full alignment check if wear is uneven.

issues.t: Won't switch back to electric after refueling
issues.sym: After filling the gas tank, the car keeps running on the engine even though the battery has charge.
issues.why: RepairPal lists owners having trouble switching from maintained mode back to electric mode after refueling.
issues.next: Check the drive mode setting and try a full restart. If it persists, have the dealer check for software updates.

issues.t: Pulls to one side when braking or using regen paddles
issues.sym: The car pulls left or right when you press the brake pedal or use the steering wheel regen paddles.
issues.why: GM bulletin 19NA064 covers this pull on the 2016 ELR.
issues.next: Have a dealer inspect it and mention the bulletin. Pulling under braking can also be a stuck caliper, so get the brakes checked.

issues.sym: A low moaning noise from the rear when braking.
issues.why: GM bulletin 15-NA-031 covers this noise; the fix adds dampeners to the rear calipers.
issues.next: Ask the dealer to apply the bulletin fix.
